news.title: Absconding Kanpur-based builder nabbed in ₹52 lakh fraud case
news.para: Kalyanpur police have taken a real-estate director into custody over a Rs 52 lakh fraud case, where he allegedly lured investors with the deceptive promise of doubled investments and land deals within five years. This individual already faced nineteen prior allegations, with three associates arrested earlier this week. Authorities are actively pursuing two other directors who have not yet been apprehended.

news.title: Ghaziabad civic body launches one-time settlement for 60,000 property tax defaulters
news.para: Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation offers a settlement scheme for over sixty thousand property tax defaulters.  This initiative waives twelve percent annual penalty charges for full payment of dues.  Defaulters must declare their intent to pay by November fourteenth.  The scheme is valid until December fifteenth, aiming to recover significant revenue.  Property tax collection for 2024-25 reached six hundred nine crore rupees.

news.title: Water crisis hits 4,338 Taloja flats, Navi Mumbai residents protest outside Cidco Bhawan
news.para: Asawari Gruhasankul residents protested Cidco Bhawan over persistent water scarcity issues.  They demanded adequate potable water supply for their 4,338 apartments.  Residents expressed frustration with poor quality tanker water and daily bottled water expenses.  Cidco authorities promised to resolve the water crisis within fifteen to twenty days.  They also stated that booster pump usage by societies would face legal action.

news.title: Gujarat: Popular Builders owner Dashrath Patel denied bail in two cases
news.para: A sessions court has refused bail to Dashrath Patel, the owner of Popular Builders, in connection with two land grabbing allegations. His brother, Raman Patel, is serving a four-year prison term for a related Chekhla land case. Both have been charged with forgery and cheating linked to land deals. The court's decision reflects concerns about potential witness tampering and has significant implications for their ongoing legal battle.

news.title: DLF-3 residents in Gurugram seek policy for workforce housing amid razing
news.para: Residents of DLF-3 organized a large meeting to voice their demands for a housing policy that benefits local workers. They protested against government actions of sealing and demolitions that jeopardize accommodation for the workforce. Advocating for the right to remedy property violations through payments, they emphasized the need for a comprehensive legal framework encompassing guest and rental housing options.

news.title: Land audit in 17 cities of Uttar Pradesh to identify encroached plots
news.para: A comprehensive audit aims to pinpoint encroached land parcels located in urban environments. The urban development department plans to embark on a meticulous land survey, which will span civic body jurisdictions and gram sabha territories. Encroached lands will be reclaimed, marked for clarity, and local governance will proceed with demolition efforts to restore these land areas.

news.title: We'll fix 22A errors, give genuine owners relief within days: Telangana revenue minister
news.para: Revenue minister Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy has acknowledged the ongoing property registration challenges, attributing them to administrative mistakes. These errors have led to incorrect listings of private properties, exacerbated by inconsistencies in land records and numbering. In response, the government is taking swift action to rectify these issues and aims to resume property registrations soon. A dedicated committee will be established to prevent future discrepancies.

news.title: Maintenance paid, but Noida RWAs want tenants to shell out extra fees for using gym, pool
news.para: Tenants in Noida are now being charged extra for using amenities such as pools, as suggested by Resident Welfare Associations citing the need for security and maintenance funds. However, tenants contend they should enjoy the same privileges due to their legal occupancy. After several incidents involving equipment damage, some societies have adopted these additional fees.

news.title: Bihar RERA launches drive to speed up dues recovery from defaulting builders
news.para: In a bid to streamline the reclaiming of dues from negligent builders, Bihar Rera has kicked off a specialized campaign. A commendable step saw a defaulting builder settling a complainant with Rs 13 lakh following Rera’s directive. The campaign seeks to facilitate homebuyers in recovering their investments more swiftly, minimizing the need for legal action. In another case, Rs 7 lakh were recovered from a different builder.

news.title: Mohali court denies bail to builder Ajay Sehgal in money laundering case
news.para: A local court has ruled against granting bail to builder Ajay Sehgal, as his application failed to meet the requirements outlined in the PMLA. The court highlighted the serious nature of allegations claiming that Sehgal had both generated and diverted funds linked to criminal activities. Additionally, the possibility of him absconding or interfering with evidence prompted the additional sessions judge to reject Sehgal's request for bail.

news.title: Ghaziabad: Consumer forum orders Solitaire Real Infra to complete & hand over flat to buyers in 30 days
news.para: A consumer commission has directed Solitaire Real Infra to fulfill its commitment by completing the construction and delivering a flat. The developer's failure to adhere to a buyer agreement from 2019 led to considerable delays for the couple, who had already invested significantly in the property. The commission identified a deficiency in service due to non-completion, setting a precedent for many NCR homebuyers experiencing similar challenges.

news.title: No Kolkata civic body's building panel meet in six months, over 300 realty projects stuck
news.para: Kolkata's Municipal Building Committee has not convened for the past six months, causing a standstill for over 300 construction projects throughout the area. This lag has significantly impacted commercial, residential, hospital, and educational developments. Developers are left in limbo over timelines and financial investments, largely due to bureaucratic delays rooted in the approval processes and ongoing political shifts since the assembly elections.

news.title: ED attaches properties worth ₹71.60-crore in 32nd Avenue Group money laundering case
news.para: ED said its investigation has revealed an "organised and systematic modus operandi" in which investors were induced to purchase commercial units in lieu of assured long-term leases, fixed rental income, buy-back arrangements and periodic increase of returns.

news.title: Maharashtra government lifts ban on state-owned land allotment to housing societies
news.para: Maharashtra government has ended its long-standing freeze on state land allotments for housing societies after a decade. This innovative policy introduces a requirement for 20 percent of members to be from backward classes and 5 percent from disabled communities. Furthermore, land will now be auctioned openly, encouraging transparency, and includes specific reservations for artists and employees, ultimately aiming to enhance housing prospects for citizens.

news.title: Kolte-Patil Developers appoints Hrishikesh Parandekar as CEO
news.para: Kolte-Patil Developers has appointed Hrishikesh Parandekar as its new Chief Executive Officer. This significant leadership change will take effect on August 24, 2026. Parandekar brings over three decades of extensive experience in real estate and strategic leadership. He will now spearhead the company's future growth and operational expansion. Blackstone currently holds a substantial 40 percent stake in the realty firm.

news.title: Arkade Developers adds four redevelopment projects in Mumbai
news.para: Arkade Developers has added four redevelopment projects across Malad, Kandivali and Borivali in western Mumbai. The projects span 11.17 acres and have a projected saleable carpet area of about 15 lakh sq ft.

news.title: Delhi: NDMC unlikely to roll out unit area property tax system this fiscal
news.para: Property tax reforms by the New Delhi Municipal Council are currently stalled this financial year, much to the frustration of traders grappling with high tax bills based on unrealistic rental values. The central government’s green light and gazette notification for the unit area method, which aims to standardize property tax assessments, remain unresolved, indicating a protracted implementation process.

news.title: MiC approves property tax framework for unauthorized colonies in Indore
news.para: The Mayor-in-Council has given the green light for property tax reforms aimed at residents with legitimate ownership documents. In addition, significant infrastructure projects and public-private partnerships were sanctioned. A new link road will connect Kanadia Road to Khajrana Temple, improving traffic conditions. Plans have also been set for new commercial markets in Subhash Nagar and Vallabh Nagar.

news.title: Ahmedabad civic body suspends development permission of Bodakdev high-rise over TOZ eligibility
news.para: The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation has suspended the development approval for a high-rise due to doubts about its compliance with Transit Oriented Zone regulations. Initially sanctioned with an excessive Floor Space Index, the project is now under scrutiny. Officials are insisting on a complete re-assessment of its TOZ eligibility, leading to ongoing suspension of development activities until verification is complete.

news.title: Nagpur civic body to freeze bank accounts, seize TVs & fridge of property tax defaulters
news.para: The Nagpur Municipal Corporation is gearing up for an assertive property tax collection initiative. To recover outstanding dues, the civic body plans to freeze bank accounts and seize properties of those who default on payments. This crucial recovery operation will focus on collecting substantial arrears from local businesses, with teams deployed throughout the city. Citizens are advised to address their tax obligations promptly to evade penalties.
